in_hebrew.name: בטסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Betsey is derived from the Hebrew word 'bet' which means 'house' and 'El' which means 'God'. Thus, Betsey means 'house of God'.

in_greek.name: Βετσέια
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Betsey is derived from the Hebrew name 'Bethesda'. In Greek, 'Bethesda' is transliterated as 'Βετσέια' and means 'House of God'.

in_latin.name: Betsia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Betsia is derived from the Hebrew name 'Bethesda'. In Latin, 'Betsia' is a direct translation of the Greek name 'Βετσέια' and also means 'House of God'.
